plainLanguage: Laredo builds to the 2021 IRC, 2021 energy code, 2021 plumbing code (IPC) and 2020 electrical code, adopted in 2024. It is inland, so no windstorm certificate is needed. The basic single-family district R-1 is about 7,200 sq ft lots with 25 ft front, 5 ft side and 20 ft rear setbacks and a 35 ft height limit (many new subdivisions use smaller R-1A/R-1B lots; confirm). City permit plus plan check runs $0.68 per sq ft, about $1,950 for a 2,400 sq ft home with garage. Utility lot and connection charges are extra.
